hints.title: Path Quality and Unique Collection
hints.text: A node value is collected only on the first visit along a valid route starting and ending at node zero.

hints.title: Backtracking Traversal
hints.text: Explore adjacent nodes recursively while tracking accumulated travel time and visit counts.

hints.title: Origin Re-entry Condition
hints.text: Whenever the route returns to the starting vertex within the time limit, update the global maximum quality.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.space: O(V + E) adjacency graph and recursion stack
complexity.notes: Node values contribute only on the initial visit and remain zero on revisits during the same path.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Standard shortest path algorithms do not account for revisiting nodes to collect rewards.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Bounded recursion time limit prevents infinite search across cyclic paths.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Candidate should increment visit counts to add node value uniquely on first entry.
